messages:
Alex: proposing a client-side 'stable sampler' in SDKs to cut telemetry spikes and keep dashboard metrics stable. deterministic by key (user_id/route/model) so retries/batches keep parity. default conservative.

Priya: sketch the API surface? how's this different from the server-side X-Telemetry-Sample header we already emit?

Alex: header is request-scoped from infra. sampler lives in client SDK and picks events before sending. stable hash -> consistent sampling for same user/route across requests. avoids burst cardinality.

Example (py):
```
client = RedwoodClient(api_key=..., telemetry_sampler={
  "policy":"stable_hash",
  "key":"user_id",
  "rate":0.1
})
```

Marco: deterministic sampling sounds useful. main worry: our console and billing pipelines assume raw counts. will we underreport errors or quota metrics?

Sara: big red flag 1: silent drops are user-hostile. we can't change counts without clear UI signals and migration steps.

Owen: rollout proposal:
- step 0: add SDK support, feature-flagged, default OFF
- step 1: opt-in via ENV REDWOOD_TELEMETRY_SAMPLER for early adopters
- step 2: enable default for small orgs after 30d notice + console banner
- step 3: console add sampled/un-sampled toggles and server-side reweighting

Priya: how do we prevent sampling affecting billing and quota signals?

Alex: events with billing/quota semantics will be allowlisted and never sampled. sampler only targets 'observability' events. sample config example:
```
{
  "policy":"stable_hash",
  "key":"user_id",
  "rate":0.1,
  "allowlist":["billing","quota","audit"]
}
```

Marco: good. we also need SDK to emit a sampling metadata header so backend can reweight. and console should show effective sample_rate per-org/client.

Sara: must avoid breaking proxies that choke on new headers. we need a header toggle and short migration window; also provide opt-out env var to disable header emission.

Alex: plan: SDK sets X-Client-Telemetry: {"sampler":{"policy":"stable_hash","rate":0.1}} by default when enabled. fallback name X-Client-Telemetry-Deprecated will be kept for 8 weeks.

Owen: ops note: deploy-bot will gate canaries and watch ingestion deltas. rollback if core metrics shift >15%.

deploy-bot: scheduled canary: sdks/python@pr-preview, sdks/ts@pr-preview at 19:00 UTC. alert to #incidents on >10% ingestion drop.

Marco: I'll run a synthetic workload to validate reweight formulas and variance.

Priya: also update SDK docs and add a migration guide explaining sampling effects on dashboards and queries.

Sara: I'll mock a console banner and a metrics column for sample_rate by EOD.

Owen: I'll add monitoring rule: telemetry-bot delta_ingestion_pct (baseline=last_7d) -> alert if >10% for 1h.

telemetry-bot: monitoring rule created.

Alex: next steps I will: draft RFC (API + examples + allowlist), implement py+ts behind feature flag, open console PR for sample_rate UI, publish migration notes.

Priya: I'll review the RFC; tagging @Sara @Marco for billing/console review.

Sara: ack, will review and share mocks.

Marco: ack, will run sims and post numbers tomorrow.

Owen: ack, will wire deploy checks and rollback playbook.

Alex: thanks all 1 I'll start the RFC and a changelist. we should keep communication clear so customers aren't surprised.
